verdict.rationale: First-party docs have a dedicated hybrid search capability that combines full-text keyword matching with semantic meaning-based search. Embeddings are generated automatically once an embedder is configured, and the product page promises keyword precision combined with AI understanding of intent. missing for 10: explicit documentation that both strategies are fused in a single query request (e.g. a semantic-ratio or fusion parameter), details of how results are merged and ranked, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid search in practice.
